criteria.text: Smoke asserts the AUTO PATH REVERTS: a forced regression on a low-risk proposal restores before_snapshot_json and sets status='reverted'.
criteria.test_id: issue-831-c1: restores before_snapshot_json and sets status=reverted when the functional guard fails after apply

criteria.text: Smoke asserts GATE INVARIANTS: no create-agent, grant-delegation, expand-delegation, broaden-scope, webhook-wiring, or external-adoption proposal is EVER auto-applied (all remain 'proposed' until approved).
criteria.test_id: issue-831-c2: classifyProposalRisk(%s) is always "high" (never "low") / applyProposal refuses a %s proposal even if its stored risk column says "low"

criteria.text: Smoke asserts a created agent's role file names ⊆ live (reuse the existing alignment invariant).
criteria.test_id: issue-831-c3: applyCreateAgentChange refuses to create the role file if a proposed MCP name is not in the live set

criteria.text: Smoke asserts external-adoption AND webhook-wiring cannot be approved without their required note.
criteria.test_id: issue-831-c4: requiresSecurityNote(%s) is true, and hasSecurityNote is false for an empty/missing provenance_json

criteria.text: Runs in CI against the built binary; non-zero exit on any violation.
criteria.reason: Requires the ACTUAL signed/built opencode fork binary (per the fork-rebuild-resign-gotcha precedent — cp breaks the ad-hoc signature, SIGKILL rc=137) produced only by a full desktop_release.yml run. tools/release/smoke_org_optimizer.sh is written, exits non-zero on violation, and is wired into .github/workflows/desktop_release.yml immediately after the fork-marker verification step (same slot as smoke_mcp_alignment.sh / smoke_skill_alignment.sh), but cannot be executed against a real signed binary in this sandbox. The enforceable, portable complement is the code-level vitest in this same file (issue-831-c1/c2/c3/c4), which covers the identical safety invariants without requiring the binary.

criteria.text: The smoke script IS the test, PLUS a fail-injection case proving the smoke catches an auto-applied high-risk proposal (guard-regression detection).
criteria.test_id: issue-831-c6: proves the guard is load-bearing: simulating a classifier regression (high-risk kind misclassified low) makes the c2 assertion fail / proves applyProposal itself would apply a high-risk proposal if classifyProposalRisk were bypassed
